About World

World (formerly Worldcoin) is an identity and finance network that uses the Orb device to verify that users are unique humans. WLD is its utility and governance token.

Where this WLD price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (WLD-USD), Binance (WLD/USDT) and Kraken (WLD/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 2.05B WLD (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
